note: Starting networks offered on first run. A starter is a small, complete, legal airline: something a stranger can read in one screen and immediately change. The shipped example network is deliberately NOT one of these — it is too large to see your own fingerprints in.

schema.name: what the picker calls it
schema.blurb: one line on what this starter is for and what it teaches
schema.brand: placeholder airline name, expected to be overwritten immediately
schema.state: partial state overlaid on baseline(): stations, roles, routes, roster, feed, spacing, redeye, spare
schema.expect: metrics this starter must produce. verify.py asserts these and that all ten checks pass. A starter with no expect block is a starter that can rot silently.
